notes.title: fault series: Behind The Scenes
notes.notes:
Istariana vilseriol, comrades!

In years of development, we've been always dreaming about one thing: Motion. A neat thing that makes characters to feel more lively, backgrounds to be more natural, overall experience to be more improved while reading. Today, we want to share with you behind the scenes video about our work we made in past month.
So please, watch this video and enjoy. (Everything is in Japanese language at this moment.)

[previewyoutube=F1lpuaALI10;full][/previewyoutube]

We got more stuff coming up, so do stick around with us.
You are also more than welcome to join us on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/faultseries]Discord server[/url] where you can talk with other citizens of Rughzenhaide and keep an eye out on more cool stuff.

Thank you and have a very nice day.
